config_notes: The streaming OpenAI builder exposes no retry setter.
Intermediate finish reasons and tool requests are recorded only in callback_only.
Anthropic base URL uses the cell root followed by /v1/.
Anthropic max_tokens is explicitly 1024, sufficient for the replayed control call.

Blocking OpenAiChatModel and AnthropicChatModel builders use timeout(Duration) and maxRetries(0) (the default is 2 retries); AiServices returns Result<String>, whose finalResponse() and finishReason() preserve the final caller response. Result.intermediateResponses() is recorded in callback_only, like onIntermediateResponse on the streaming surface.

On model-stream the caller view is the ChatResponse passed to onCompleteResponse. onPartialToolCall and onCompleteToolCall are optional callbacks with default no-op bodies; what they deliver is recorded in callback_only (partial_tool_calls, complete_tool_calls) and does not decide the category.

timeout(Duration) sets the connect and read timeouts of the HTTP client. With the JDK client the read timeout becomes HttpRequest.timeout, which ends when the response head arrives; with the OkHttp client it is a socket read timeout.

The okhttp build profile uses the matching beta HTTP-client module and excludes the JDK client; the model builder receives the sole discovered client explicitly and its type is checked before labelling the result.
